capabilities.label: Search fixture knowledge
capabilities.purpose: Search bounded records from one authorized fixture-knowledge connector.
use_when: The user asks for evidence held by this configured fixture connector.
do_not_use_when: The request concerns Nexus documentation or runtime evidence instead.
preconditions: The server bound an eligible connector instance to this request.

failure_recovery.unavailable: Report that the connector is unavailable without inventing evidence.
failure_recovery.failed: Report the safe failure and retry only when marked retryable.

description: Read-only, allowlisted HTTP search index connector.

capabilities.label: Search external index
capabilities.purpose: Search bounded records from one authorized external index connector.
use_when: The user asks for evidence held by this configured external index.
do_not_use_when: The request concerns Nexus documentation or runtime evidence instead.
preconditions: The server bound an eligible healthy connector instance to this request.

failure_recovery.unavailable: Report that the connector is unavailable without inventing evidence.
failure_recovery.failed: Report the safe failure and retry only when marked retryable.
